subject: Vendor enrollment: PayBridge reference ID, invoice format & bank confirmation
messages:
From: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@aurelia-logistics.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@aurelia-logistics.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood vendor registration + invoice reference ID

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier this week. To complete Redwood's vendor enrollment in our AP system (PayBridge), we need the following items from you: 

1) The vendor reference ID you would like us to use on Purchase Orders and remittance records (example: REDWOOD-ACCT-XXXXX).
2) Your preferred invoice numbering scheme and a sample invoice (PDF or XLSX) so our matching rules accept your submissions.
3) Tax proof: W-9 for US entity or VAT registration certificate for EU entities.
4) Bank details and confirmation of whether you accept ACH only or EFT + wire (we have a 3-day ACH cutoff for payments).
5) Any EDI/CSV column mapping notes if you plan to push invoices via SFTP/API.

We attached the PayBridge vendor token link below — please register and then return your enrollment packet. If you can get this to us by COB next Tuesday (11/10) we can include Redwood on the next AP cycle.

Attachments: vendor_register_instructions.pdf (from PayBridge)

Questions? Reply here or feel free to schedule a slot with me: https://calendly.com/olivia-ramos/15min

Thanks,
Olivia Ramos
Sr. AP Manager | Aurelia Logistics
olivia.ramos@aurelia-logistics.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@aurelia-logistics.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@aurelia-logistics.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration + invoice reference ID

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to proceed. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Preferred vendor reference ID: REDWOOD-INF-00084 (please use this on POs and remittance references).
2) Invoice numbering: we currently issue invoices as RW-YYYYMMDD-<seq>. Example file attached (sample_invoice_v2.xlsx). Please confirm whether your matcher accepts a dash-delimited invoice ID in the Invoice# field.
3) Tax proof: attaching our US W-9 equivalent and a stub showing VAT registration for our EU entity where applicable (redwood_w9_or_vat_stub.txt).
4) Banking: we support ACH and wire. I'll need finance to confirm the routed account details before we publish full bank information.
5) EDI/CSV: we can export invoices via SFTP in a simple CSV. Attached is a sample CSV column mapping; if PayBridge requires a specific schema we can adapt.

Attached: Redwood_Vendor_Enrollment_Form.pdf; sample_invoice_v2.xlsx; redwood_w9_or_vat_stub.txt

We'll start the PayBridge portal registration this afternoon. Laura (Finance) — can you confirm the account number and whether we want ACH-only terms for Aurelia?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Office: +1 650-555-0167

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Redwood vendor registration + invoice reference ID — action items

Team — forwarding Aurelia's AP request. Key asks: bank confirmation and whether we lock to ACH-only (they have 3-day cutoff), confirm invoice sample format OK, and any compliance flags on the vendor enrollment form.

Can we triage:
- Laura: confirm bank/account + whether to accept both ACH and wire.
- Kimberly: any billing cadence restrictions we should call out (e.g., final net-30 or early-pay discounts)?
- Vivek: if Aurelia wants SFTP with structured CSV, can your team generate an automated export of the invoice CSV with the attached mapping? What fields might be tricky?
- Priyom: FYI for the account; the Aurelia procurement team may check invoice formatting on the first PO — please be available for follow-up.

I'll start portal registration and upload the vendor form.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood vendor registration + invoice reference ID — action items

Marissa — confirmed with treasury: we will provide full bank details once Aurelia confirms the remittance endpoint (ACH vs wire). Treasury prefers ACH where possible due to lower fees. We can support both if Aurelia provides a wire-template (routing, intermediary bank) and signs the enrollment form.

Also: earliest payment cycle we can guarantee for a new vendor is Net-30 after invoice receipt and successful PO-match. If Aurelia wants earlier payment (e.g., Net-7 or early-pay discounts) we need to set that in the vendor terms. Kimberly — can you advise on whether we want to offer early-pay to this account?

I'll attach the bank stub to the portal once they confirm ACH/WIRE preference.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: accounts-payable@aurelia-logistics.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@aurelia-logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration + invoice reference ID

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

• We have registered REDWOOD-INF-00084 in PayBridge. You'll receive a confirmation email from the portal shortly.
• Confirmed that PayBridge accepts dash-delimited Invoice# values — the example in sample_invoice_v2.xlsx looks good.
• We prefer ACH for routine payments but will accept wire for one-off expedited settlements. Please upload bank details and indicate 'ACH primary / wire fallback' on the enrollment form.
• For SFTP CSV ingestion, see the attached mapping doc (PayBridge expects columns: PO_Number, Invoice_Number, Invoice_Date, Vendor_Ref, Line_Total, Tax_Amount, Remit_Account). Your sample CSV should include Vendor_Ref matching REDWOOD-INF-00084.

We are sending a test PO now (PO#: AUR-2026-11877) for $18,430. Please confirm once you receive it and route the invoice with the matching Vendor_Ref so our matcher clears automatically. If you anticipate any mapping issues, let us know before EOD tomorrow so we can adjust.

Thanks,
Aurelia Accounts Payable Team
accounts-payable@aurelia-logistics.com
